Definition: Ephron, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ephron = "fawn-like"; n pr m; 1) a Hittite, son of Zohar and the one from whom Abraham bought the field and cave of Machpelah; n pr loc; 2) a city on the borders of Benjamin; 3) a mountain on the northern border of Judah
